summary:
We developed TerraRotate AI, an open-source, bilingual (English & Turkish) regenerative crop rotation decision support platform powered by Live NASA Earth Observations. By fusing real time NASA POWER climatology, SMAP root-zone soil moisture, GPM precipitation, MODIS/Landsat-9 NDVI, ECOSTRESS thermal stress, and GRACE-FO groundwater data with offical cadastral parcel boundaries (TKGM) and 15-minute live field telemetry, TerraRotate AI transforms complex orbital data into actionable 4-year crop sequences

Instead of relying on exhausting monoculture, farmers can simulate soil organic matter (SOM) recovery, test *30% climate drought shoucks, calculate exact seed/fertilizer prescriptions, and consult our built-in voice enabled agronomist, Mekto AI. This matters because global agriculture faces severe soil degradation, aquifer depletion, and rising fertilizer costs-TerraRotate AI empowers farmers to boost net profit, cut synthetic fertilizer and water usage, and rebuild living soil directly from space to field insights.
details:
What ıt Does & How It Works:TerraRotate AI turns live NASA Earth Observations into actionable 4-year regenerative crop rotation plans. Farmers click any field on our satellite map or query official cadastral parcels (TKGM) to combine NASA POWER climatology, MODIS NDVI, and 15-minute live soil/weather telemetry with soil physics, a ±30% drought simulator, and our voice-enabled agronomist, Mekto AI.

Benefits & Intended Impact:

By sequencing nitrogen-fixing legumes and deep-taproot crops instead of monoculture, farmers can cut synthetic fertilizer by up to 65%, save up to 38% irrigation water, restore Soil Organic Matter (SOM), and boost net profit (+42%) while protecting aquifers and fighting soil degradation.

Tools & Tech Used:

JavaScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet, Recharts, GSAP, Lenis, NASA POWER & GIBS (MODIS NDVI) APIs, Open-Meteo, TKGM Parcel API, Web Speech API, Google Antigravity (Gemini 4 Hydrogen), Edge Neural TTS, GitHub, and Netlify.

Creativity & Factors Considered:

We bridge orbital data directly to legal parcel boundaries, seed/fertilizer bag prescriptions, and printable PDF action plans—factoring in soil pH, hardpan compaction, drought risk, bilingual (EN/TR) accessibility, and offline PWA/single-file support for rural farmers.
